Class SubscriberRepository

java.lang.Object
com.andreibel.server.dbController.repository.SubscriberRepository
public class SubscriberRepository extends Object
JDBC repository (DAO) for Subscriber entities.

This class provides low-level CRUD operations for the bistro.subscriber table using plain JDBC. It relies on TransactionManager to supply the current transactional Connection via tx.currentConnection().

Transaction requirement: Most methods throw SQLException and assume they are called inside an active transaction (for example, through tx.inTransaction(...)). If there is no active transaction, tx.currentConnection() may fail or use an unexpected connection.

Singleton: Implemented as a singleton to keep a single repository instance across the server lifecycle.

Mapping: ResultSet rows are converted to Subscriber using SubscriberMapper.mapRelToSubscriber(ResultSet).

Author:
Andrei Beloziyorove

    • addSubscriber

      public Subscriber addSubscriber(com.andreibel.message.DTO.SubscriberRequest sub) throws SQLException
      Inserts a new subscriber and returns the persisted entity (reloaded from DB).

      Expected fields in request: email, name, phoneNumber.

      SQL: 

      INSERT INTO bistro.`Subscriber` (`email`, `name`, `phoneNumber`)
VALUES (?,?,?);

      This method executes an INSERT, reads the generated primary key, and then calls findById(int) to return the stored row.

      Parameters:
      sub - subscriber creation request DTO
      Returns:
      stored subscriber (as persisted in DB)
      Throws:
      SQLException - if a JDBC error occurs or if no generated key is returned

    • findById

      public Subscriber findById(int subscriberId) throws SQLException
      Finds a subscriber by its primary key.

      SQL: 

      SELECT *
FROM bistro.`Subscriber`
WHERE subscriberId = ?;

      Parameters:
      subscriberId - subscriber primary key
      Returns:
      matching subscriber, or null if not found
      Throws:
      SQLException - if a JDBC error occurs

    • updateBySubID

      public void updateBySubID(com.andreibel.message.DTO.SubscriberRequest data)
      Updates an existing subscriber by its subscriberId.

      Expected fields in request: subscriberId, name, phoneNumber, email.

      SQL: 

      UPDATE bistro.`Subscriber`
SET name = ?, phoneNumber = ?, email = ?
WHERE subscriberId = ?;

      Error handling: This method currently catches SQLException and prints the stack trace instead of propagating the error. In most repository designs it is preferable to declare throws SQLException so the service layer can decide how to handle failures.

      Parameters:
      data - DTO containing subscriber id and updated fields
